name: Laravel 12 + Sanctum REST API
note: Each task runs a real command. No token figures are recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost directly from the kit files. The suite runs against SQLite in-memory (DB_CONNECTION=sqlite, DB_DATABASE=:memory: in phpunit.xml) so no MySQL or Postgres service is required.

eval_tasks.title: Application installs and boots
eval_tasks.instruction: Composer dependencies must resolve and the Laravel application must bootstrap far enough to list its routes.
assertions: vendor/autoload.php exists
artisan route:list exits 0
the v1 API routes are registered

eval_tasks.title: Auth and project API round-trip
eval_tasks.instruction: Token issue, authenticated listing, BOLA refusal and ability gating must all behave as specified.
assertions: login returns a bearer token
invalid credentials return 422
unauthenticated request returns 401
a user lists only their own projects
cross-tenant project access is refused
a token without write ability cannot create

eval_tasks.title: Declared security controls hold under test
eval_tasks.instruction: Run the suite that exercises the controls named in security/checks.json. Each test is mutation-verified: removing the control makes the test fail.
assertions: SEC-02 cross-tenant update and delete are refused with 403
SEC-03 list queries never return another tenant's rows
SEC-04 token abilities gate read and write independently
SEC-05 sanctum token expiration is configured
SEC-06 the login endpoint returns 429 under repeated attempts
SEC-07 password and remember_token never appear in a response
SEC-08 a filter outside the Spatie whitelist is rejected with 400
SEC-10 .env.example ships an empty APP_KEY and no BOM
SEC-12 invalid status and out-of-range priority return 422
SEC-13 a bearer-token write succeeds with no CSRF token
a payload cannot reassign project ownership via user_id

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete feature and security suite must pass with no failures.
assertions: phpunit exits 0 across tests/Feature
